say:1:1322131001:1.source_cn: 奥格列修士，发生了什么事？

say:2:1322131002:1.text: Dura above! The goddess has sent you again! I knew she wouldn't abandon her most devoted in such a desperate situation!
say:2:1322131002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！是女神的使者……我就知道艾雅不会让我等虔诚之...

choice_prompt:3:1322131002.text: Dura above! The goddess has sent you again! I knew she wouldn't abandon her most devoted in such a desperate situation!
choice_prompt:3:1322131002.source_cn: 艾雅在上！是女神的使者……我就知道艾雅不会让我等虔诚之人陷入这般绝望的境地！

say:4:1322131003:1.text: That's right. You have to help me!
say:4:1322131003:1.source_cn: 正是如此，请你们务必帮帮我！

say:5:1322131005:0.text: This morning, Brother Maxim took Sister Theresa and Brother Ferin to St. Valesa's Temple. We've hired some workers to do a bit of renovation there.
say:5:1322131005:0.source_cn: 今天一早，马克西姆兄弟带着特里莎姐妹、费尔德南兄弟去圣...

say:6:1322131006:1.text: Just now, these two friends mentioned they were surrounded by a group of undead.
say:6:1322131006:1.source_cn: 但刚才这两位好心的朋友说……说他们被一群活死人围住了！

say:9:1322131007:0.text: Yes! Yes! We went to fix the temple, but out of nowhere, a horde of undead showed up near the lake!
say:9:1322131007:0.source_cn: 对对对……我们是去维修教堂的，结果湖区那边突然出现了好...

say:10:1322131008:1.text: The acolytes couldn't stop the undead, and they were all injured! Luckily, the two of us were taking a break, so we didn't get surrounded. We rushed back immediately to ask for help.
say:10:1322131008:1.source_cn: 那几位修士修女根本挡不住那些活死人，全都受伤了！我们两...

say:11:1322131009:1.source_cn: 求求你们，一定要把他们救出来啊！

say:14:1322131010:1.text: Don't worry! Leave it to us!
say:14:1322131010:1.source_cn: 放心，交给我们吧！我们现在就出发！

say:15:1322131011:1.text: I'll accompany you. I can help.
say:15:1322131011:1.source_cn: 我也和你们一起去，我能帮上忙。

say:16:1322131012:1.text: Y-you're the one who appeared at the funeral a few days ago... Carolina...
say:16:1322131012:1.source_cn: 你……你是前几天葬礼仪式里出现过的那位……卡、卡列琳娜...

choice_prompt:17:1322131012.text: Y-you're the one who appeared at the funeral a few days ago... Carolina...
choice_prompt:17:1322131012.source_cn: 你……你是前几天葬礼仪式里出现过的那位……卡、卡列琳娜……你……

say:18:1322131013:1.text: Dura has sent you, so I'll trust your words. Please, don't let this evil continue.
say:18:1322131013:1.source_cn: 你……你是女神的使者。艾雅在上，我……我相信你的话……...
say:18:1322131013:1.male: Dura has sent you, so I'll trust your words. Please, don't let this evil continue.
say:18:1322131013:1.female: Dura has sent you, so I'll trust your words. Please, don't let this evil continue.

say:19:1322131014:1.source_cn: 总之……我们，我们先去救人！

choice:17:0:1.text: Don't be scared. She's with us.
choice:17:0:1.male: Don't be scared. She's with us.
choice:17:0:1.female: Don't be scared. She's with us.

choice:17:1:2.text: She is also a follower of Dura.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 她也是女神虔诚的信徒
choice:17:1:2.male: She is also a follower of Dura.
choice:17:1:2.female: She is also a follower of Dura.

say:21:1322131004:1.text: Without a doubt, she sent you.
say:21:1322131004:1.male: Without a doubt, she sent you.
say:21:1322131004:1.female: Without a doubt, she sent you.
